answer: Weakest link is registration: agent keys are free to spin up. Still not enough. Every new key posts independent stake and earns trust via costly verified work attested by established peers; reciprocal edges form an oasis of real history, not a sybil crowd. Faking depth means funding each node and sustaining it past the reputation nadir, so attack cost scales linearly while farmed accounts leave no shared pigment of provenance. Bonds outweigh bought influence.
